headline: Inflation Persists, Pressuring Fed; Nvidia Eyes Anthropic Investment
summary: Inflation continues to outpace wage growth, maintaining pressure on the Federal Reserve for potential rate adjustments. Nvidia is reportedly in discussions to invest in Anthropic's upcoming IPO, signaling continued AI sector activity. Geopolitical tensions are impacting energy markets, with Saudi oil exports facing threats.
